svg.title: Current corrected AIDEAL evaluation workflow
svg.desc: Freeze inputs, pass deterministic readiness checks, generate fresh Original and existing D1 programs at R0, run native checks, report diagnostic results, then replay historical saved programs separately without model calls. The initial run was stopped for shared input-contract omissions; replacement input-contract checks passed and its paid run started after publication.

g.text: Current run: Original R0 and existing D1 R0
2,823 targets · 7 banks / 6 libraries · 5,646 initial target requests · 0 historical results reused
Running: mir_eval + Thumbnailator active; five banks queued. Snapshot 19 Nov, 00:10 UTC.
Save full output and error text
Any unmet gate stops paid generation.
5. Report fresh R0 results by bank and condition
Native acceptance, failures, tokens, model time and execution time
Model-written checks do not establish independent task correctness.
Re-execute saved programs with corrected execution checks
Zero model calls · retain original verdicts and historical target IDs
D1 names a generated document version. R0 names an initial audience program.
This launch does not regenerate D1, repair programs at R1/R2, revise D2, or run aliases, hints or puzzle ablations.
Readiness: explicit-inputs-r0/operator/ · New programs: explicit-inputs-r0/continuation/ · Historical audit: explicit-inputs-r0/rescore/
